rugra_source.archive_policy: Extract only the explicit dependency closure from the pinned commit; never read live crate files and never require runtime HEAD equality
rugra_source.base_closure_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-action-leaf-base-closure-v1 plus sorted length-prefixed relative paths and pinned archive contents

overlay.policy: The sole live library-source input; hash before replacing the pinned archive's src/coreaction.rs

analysis_options.funcdata: BfdArchitecture over the immutable 34a3febf:examples/curl Git blob; query global GetStr; no followFlow and no decompiler action pass. Before observations, replace the prototype with locked default __stdcall internal storage, locked void input/output, and zero calls/ops/blocks/varnodes.
analysis_options.starttypes: A real rule_repeatapply ActionGroup contains a read-only type-recovery observer followed by the real ActionStartTypes. The same Funcdata is retained across reset so typerecovery_start persistence is observed.
analysis_options.once_zero_work: Each real leaf is reset, performed twice, reset, and performed once more. ActionExtraPopSetup receives a null stackspace, selecting the locked early return. All other leaf loops execute their legal empty boundary.
analysis_options.executor_adapter: C++ probe subclasses expose inherited protected Action state and count virtual calls; as a shared deterministic precondition they initialize the Ghidra base constructor's otherwise indeterminate count/lcount fields to zero, which is overwritten by the first perform and is not claimed as production constructor semantics. Rust stores the same inherited fields in ActionState; the wrapper forwards get_flags, prepare_apply, reset, apply, and take_count_delta without otherwise synthesizing changes.
analysis_options.warnings: rule_warnings_on is absent in every case
analysis_options.debug_macros: __TERMINAL__ only through the locked Makefile libdecomp closure; OPACTION_DEBUG, CPUI_DEBUG, and TYPEPROP_DEBUG are absent
analysis_options.normalization: None; one fixed-order compact UTF-8 JSON object and final newline are compared byte-for-byte

binary.source_policy: Materialize the pinned provenance commit's examples/curl Git blob by verified object ID; never read the working-tree file and never require runtime HEAD equality

observation_schema.format: One compact UTF-8 JSON object with fixed key order and a final newline
observation_schema.starttypes: Event label/return, exact pre-child type-start observations, parent executor state, both child states, cumulative apply/reset calls, and full Funcdata fingerprint
observation_schema.once_leaf: Fixed action/event order, raw/effective flags, executor status/count/lcount/count_tests/count_apply, cumulative apply/reset calls, and full Funcdata fingerprint
observation_schema.funcdata_fingerprint: type-recovery on/started, calls, alive ops, blocks, varnodes, prototype model/input/output locks, exact model name, and active-output presence
observation_schema.preserved: All action, event, phase, status, counter, call, and state-field order; no field is normalized

build.oracle_archive: git archive of exact oracle commit followed by locked Makefile libdecomp.a target; never a working-tree Ghidra archive
build.rugra_archive: Explicit Cargo/build dependency closure extracted from immutable Rugra commit 8ce126c3; the only live library-source overlay is hash-pinned src/coreaction.rs
build.rust_build: Pinned Rugra archive plus one hashed coreaction overlay; every Cargo.lock registry archive is checksum-verified and securely expanded into an isolated vendor tree before Cargo --locked --offline; rustc compiles the separately hashed fixture against that library
build.environment_policy: Immutable runner descriptor; env -i validation/build/execute; pinned tool paths; locked Ghidra and Rugra archives; immutable binary Git blob; copied and hashed complete BFD include/library closure; isolated checksum-verified Cargo vendor/home/target
